fee_notes: Royalty is 4% of Gross Sales, due by the 15th of each month via EFT. Marketing Fund Contribution is 1% of Gross Sales; total marketing obligations (Marketing Fund + Cooperative + local advertising) capped at 4% of Gross Sales. Advertising Cooperative Contributions are a minimum of 1% of Gross Sales if a Cooperative is established. Technology Fee is 1% of Gross Sales (not a fixed monthly fee). Renewal fee: $10,000. Transfer fee: $5,000. Relocation fee: $5,000. Supplemental Training: $250/day/person plus actual costs. Audit: cost of audit if understatement exceeds 1.5% of Gross Sales. Brand Standard Re-Audit (Mystery Shopper): $500 + travel/accommodation/meals. Interest: 18% per year on underpayment. Temporary Management Fee: 10% of Gross Sales plus reasonable costs. Supplier/Product Evaluation: $25–$500 per supplier/product. Late Fee: $100 per late or dishonored payment.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty 4% of Gross Sales Payable each month by the 15th based upon the Gross Sales in the preceding month. See Note 2 for the definition of "Gross Sales." Paid by electronic funds transfer.
Marketing Fund Contribution 1% of your Gross Sales Payable each month by the 15th based upon the Gross Sales for the preceding month. The total amount to be contributed to Marketing Fund, to any Cooperative and spent on local advertising shall not exceed 4% of Gross Sales. Due upon commencement of business.
Advertising Cooperative Contributions If created, a minimum of 1% of your Gross Sales. Payable each month by the 15th based upon the Gross Sales for the preceding month.
Technology Fee 1% of Gross Sales Payable each month on the 15th based upon the Gross Sales for the preceding month. Paid by electronic funds transfer.
Renewal Franchise $10,000 Upon signing of renewal franchise agreement.
Transfer Fee $5,000 Prior to transfer of the franchise.
Relocation Fee $5,000 Prior to relocation.
Supplemental Training $250 per day, per person; plus reimbursement of our actual costs, including travel, lodging and meals. 14 days after billing.
Audit Cost of inspection or audit 14 days after billing.
Brand Standard Re-Audit (Mystery Shopper) $500 + travel, accommodation and meals, if required 14 days after billing.
Interest 18% per year on underpayment Upon demand.
Indemnification Varies As incurred.
Costs and Attorneys' Fees Varies As incurred.
Temporary Management Fee 10% of Gross Sales, plus reasonable costs As incurred.
Supplier/Product Evaluation $25 to $500 for each supplier/product that we approve. As incurred.
Late Fee $100 When billed.
